iso45001_clauses.title: Scope
iso45001_clauses.summary: This document specifies requirements for an occupational health and safety (OH&S) management system and gives guidance for its use, to enable organizations to provide safe and healthy workplaces by preventing work-related injury and ill health, as well as by proactively improving its OH&S performance. The 2026 revision expands scope to include worker wellbeing, mental health, and new work modalities.
requirements: Specifies requirements for an OH&S management system
Applicable to any organization regardless of size, type, and activities
Intended to prevent work-related injury and ill health
Addresses worker wellbeing including physical, mental, social, and cognitive needs [citation:1]
Covers all work modalities including remote and hybrid work [citation:2]
Provides framework for managing OH&S risks and opportunities

iso45001_clauses.title: Normative references
iso45001_clauses.summary: There are no normative references in this document.

iso45001_clauses.title: Terms and definitions
iso45001_clauses.summary: For the purposes of this document, the terms and definitions given in ISO 45001 apply. Key terms include: OH&S management system, worker, participation, consultation, workplace, hazard, risk, opportunity, incident, worker wellbeing, psychosocial risk, remote work.
requirements: Refer to ISO 45001 for complete list of terms and definitions
New definitions expected for worker wellbeing, psychosocial risks, and new work modalities

iso45001_clauses.title: Context of the organization
iso45001_clauses.summary: The organization must determine external and internal issues relevant to its purpose and strategic direction that affect its ability to achieve the intended outcomes of the OH&S management system. It must identify interested parties, their needs and expectations, define the scope, and establish the OH&S management system.

iso45001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the OH&S management system to establish its scope. The scope shall be documented and consider external and internal issues, interested party requirements, and organizational activities, products, and services, including all work modalities.

iso45001_clauses.title: OH&S management system
iso45001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish, implement, maintain and continually improve an OH&S management system, including the processes needed and their interactions, in accordance with the requirements of ISO 45001.

iso45001_clauses.title: Leadership and worker participation
iso45001_clauses.summary: Top management must demonstrate leadership and commitment, establish an OH&S policy, assign organizational roles, responsibilities, and authorities, and ensure consultation and participation of workers with enhanced focus on worker wellbeing and diversity.

iso45001_clauses.title: OH&S policy
iso45001_clauses.summary: Top management shall establish, implement, and maintain an OH&S policy that is appropriate to the organization's purpose and context, provides a framework for setting OH&S objectives, includes commitments to prevent work-related injury and ill health, fulfill compliance obligations, and continual improvement, and includes a commitment to consultation and participation of workers and to worker wellbeing. The policy must be documented, communicated, and available to interested parties.

iso45001_clauses.summary: Top management shall ensure that the responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles are assigned, communicated, and understood within the organization. It shall assign responsibility and authority for ensuring OH&S conformity and reporting on OH&S performance.

iso45001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish, implement, and maintain processes for consultation and participation of workers at all applicable levels and functions. It shall provide mechanisms, time, training, and resources for participation, ensure timely access to information, and remove barriers to participation, including barriers related to diversity.

iso45001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish OH&S objectives at relevant functions and levels, considering its significant OH&S risks and opportunities and compliance obligations. iso45001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine the necessary competence of persons doing work under its control that affects its OH&S performance and ability to fulfill its compliance obligations. It shall ensure these persons are competent on the basis of education, training, or experience. Where applicable, take actions to acquire necessary competence and evaluate effectiveness. Retain documented information as evidence.

iso45001_clauses.title: Eliminating hazards and reducing OH&S risks

iso45001_clauses.title: Emergency preparedness and response
iso45001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish, implement, and maintain processes needed to prepare for and respond to potential emergency situations. It shall take action to prevent or mitigate OH&S consequences from emergencies, periodically test response procedures, review and revise processes after incidents, and provide information and training. iso45001_clauses.summary: The organization must monitor, measure, analyze, and evaluate its OH&S performance including wellbeing indicators, evaluate compliance, conduct internal audits, and perform management reviews with consideration of climate change and diversity factors.

iso45001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine what needs to be monitored and measured, methods, criteria, and when to analyze and evaluate results. iso45001_clauses.title: Internal audit
iso45001_clauses.summary: The organization shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to provide information on whether the OH&S management system conforms to the organization's own requirements and ISO 45001, and is effectively implemented and maintained. It shall establish an audit programme, define audit criteria and scope, select auditors, and report results. Audit scope shall include new requirements for wellbeing, diversity, and remote work.

iso45001_clauses.title: Management review
iso45001_clauses.summary: Top management shall review the OH&S management system at planned intervals to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness. The review shall consider status of previous actions, changes in context and interested parties including climate change, OH&S performance including wellbeing, compliance status, audit results, resources, and opportunities for improvement. Outputs shall include decisions on improvement opportunities, changes to OH&S management system, and resource needs.

iso45001_clauses.summary: The organization shall continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the OH&S management system to enhance OH&S performance and worker wellbeing, and promote a culture that supports OH&S and wellbeing.
